title: GTA 6 Extended Look Tops Netflix Top 10 Chart in First Week
description: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look dominated Netflix's English Film chart in its first week with 31.1 million views, outperforming other top titles.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Look Dominates Netflix Streaming Charts

According to a recent report from IGN Games, the video release titled *Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look* has made an explosive debut on streaming platforms, completely dominating Netflix’s top 10 chart in the English Film category during its first week of availability. The special look at Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster racked up an impressive 31.1 million views, cementing the immense global anticipation surrounding the franchise.

## Outperforming Hollywood Competition

The sheer drawing power of the Grand Theft Auto IP was on full display as it handily outperformed its traditional cinematic competition on the platform. Securing the second-place spot on the list was the thriller *The Whisper Man*, which features a star-studded cast including Robert DeNiro, Adam Scott, and Michelle Monaghan. Despite boasting well-known Hollywood talent, *The Whisper Man* pulled in 23.2 million views, falling significantly short of the massive numbers generated by the GTA 6 video content.

## A Record-Breaking Partial Week

What makes this milestone particularly noteworthy is the timeframe in which it was achieved. Industry observers noted that *GTA 6: An Extended Look* did not even debut at the beginning of the standard tracking week, instead arriving on the platform on a Thursday. Despite missing the early-week viewing window that its competitors enjoyed, the video still managed to surge past all contenders and claim the number one spot with days to spare.

## Editor's Take

The unprecedented success of the *GTA 6* extended look on Netflix proves that the franchise is a dominant force in mainstream entertainment, easily rivaling major Hollywood movie releases. It highlights the staggering level of consumer demand and excitement leading up to the game's release, showing that audiences are hungry for any official glimpse into the world of GTA 6.
